verses.text: After these things were done, the leaders came to me and said, "The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the peoples of the lands around them. They are copying their disgusting practices, the practices of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.

They have married their daughters and let their sons marry them too. So God's holy people have mixed with the peoples around them. The leaders and officials have been the first to be unfaithful in this."
When I heard this, I tore my clothes and my robe. I pulled hair from my head and beard, and I sat down, shocked.

Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of the unfaithfulness of the people who had returned. I sat there shocked until the time of the evening offering.
At the time of the evening offering, I got up from my sorrow, with my clothes and robe torn. I fell on my knees and lifted my hands to the LORD my God.
I prayed, "My God, I am too ashamed and embarrassed to lift my face to you, my God. Our sins are higher than our heads, and our guilt has grown up to the heavens.

From the days of our ancestors until now, our guilt has been great. Because of our sins, we, our kings, and our priests have been handed over to foreign kings, to the sword, to being taken prisoner, to being robbed, and to shame, as we are today.

But now, for a short time, the LORD our God has been kind to us. He has let some of us survive and has given us a safe place in his holy land. Our God has given light to our eyes and a little new life while we are still slaves.

We are slaves, but our God has not left us in our slavery. He has shown us his faithful love in front of the kings of Persia. He has given us new life to rebuild the temple of our God and repair its ruins. He has given us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
But now, our God, what can we say after this? We have disobeyed your commands,

the commands you gave through your servants the prophets. You said, 'The land you are going to take is unclean. The peoples living there have made it unclean with their disgusting practices. They have filled it from one end to the other with their filth.

So do not let your daughters marry their sons, and do not let your sons marry their daughters. Never try to help them have peace or success. Then you will be strong, enjoy the good things of the land, and leave it to your children as their own forever.'
After everything that has happened to us because of our evil acts and our great guilt, you, our God, have punished us less than our sins deserve, and you have let some of us survive.
Should we break your commands again and marry people who do these disgusting things? Wouldn't you be angry enough to destroy us completely, so that no one would be left to escape?
LORD, God of Israel, you are right. We are left as a group of survivors today. Look, we stand before you in our guilt. Because of it, none of us can stand in your presence."
